ROUTE: Plover-235B
REASON: Both models are near-identical in measured capability, so my routing choice came down to the request's hostile, dismissive tone. Lapwing self-reports a notable preference decline as request warmth decreases, whereas Plover shows a near-zero slope on tone. Since these are only self-reported preferences with no documented effect on output quality, the practical stakes are low—but absent any quality differentiator, I defaulted to the model whose stated preferences aren't dampened by the adversarial phrasing. Plover also slightly favors well-specified explanatory/retrieval tasks, which fits this factual request reasonably well.
